name: Body Saw
instructions: Get into a forearm plank with your elbows under your shoulders and your toes on sliders, towels or a slick floor.
Brace your abs and glutes so that your body is in a straight line from head to heels.
Push your body back with your forearms so that your shoulders move past your elbows.
Pull your body forward again until your shoulders are back over your elbows.
Keep sawing back and forth for the given time. Do not let your hips sag or rise.
